name: Elf (Elf 2 / Elf 3)
dof_breakdown: legs 6 each, arms 7 each, waist 3, head 2
summary: A research and teaching humanoid built by a company that makes its own hollow-shaft joint motors — 31 of them, 25 to 150 N·m — driven over PCIe-CANFD above 1 kHz with a ROS 2 SDK. BXI publishes URDF and MJCF descriptions on GitHub, so the robot has a working simulation model as well as a real one.
notable: Elf 2 finished sixth in the 2025 Beijing humanoid half marathon, unmodified
URDF and MJCF models published openly
